en_quote: Control and ownership play a vital role in AML efforts, as they can often be obscured or concealed, allowing bad actors to disguise criminal activities and facilitate financial crime.
knowledge_zh: 控制权和所有权在反洗钱工作中至关重要

en_quote: A beneficial owner (BO) is defined as an individual or entity that possesses ownership of a legal entity, either through shareholding or other means.
knowledge_zh: 受益所有人（BO）的定义：通过持股或其他方式拥有法律实体的个人或实体

en_quote: In contrast, the ultimate beneficial owner (UBO) refers specifically to one or more natural persons who ultimately owns a substantial percentage of shareholding.
knowledge_zh: 最终受益所有人（UBO）的定义：最终持有重大比例股份的自然人

en_quote: It is important to note that a BO might appear to have ownership of a company but might not control the company. Conversely, a UBO might not directly hold shares but does exert ultimate control over it.
knowledge_zh: BO 可能拥有所有权但不控制公司，UBO 可能不直接持股但实施最终控制

en_quote: This distinction is crucial when it comes to regulatory requirements surrounding ownership structures.
knowledge_zh: BO 与 UBO 的区别对所有权结构的监管要求至关重要

en_quote: When reviewing ownership structures, there is a regulatory obligation to identify the UBO of a customer.
knowledge_zh: 监管要求审查所有权结构时必须识别客户的 UBO

en_quote: For AML purposes, most jurisdictions require beneficial ownership to be identified at a threshold of 25% or more. That means you need to know every entity or individual who owns at least 25% of a customer.
knowledge_zh: 多数司法管辖区要求识别持股 25% 或以上的受益所有人

en_quote: Your organization will set the appropriate threshold using a riskbased approach.
knowledge_zh: 机构应采用风险为本的方法设定受益所有权阈值

en_quote: For certain high-risk customers, the beneficial ownership threshold might be as low as 10% and could go as low as 5% for customers who pose a significantly higher risk.
knowledge_zh: 高风险客户的受益所有人阈值可能低至 10% 甚至 5%

en_quote: For example, high-risk financial institutions with correspondent banking relationships in a high-risk jurisdiction might set their threshold at 5%.
knowledge_zh: 示例：高风险司法管辖区的代理行关系可能设定 5% 的阈值

en_quote: In order to identify the UBOs of Company A, you need to identify indirect ownership stakes in addition to direct ownership.
knowledge_zh: 识别 UBO 需要同时考虑直接和间接持股

en_quote: Individual D owns 10% of Company A directly. They also own 72% of Company A indirectly, as they own 90% of shares of Company B, which owns 80% of Company A. Individual D is then considered a UBO with 82% shareholding of Company A.
knowledge_zh: 示例：个人 D 通过直接和间接持股合计 82%，成为 UBO

en_quote: Individual C, who owns 10% of Company A directly and an additional 8% indirectly via their 10% ownership of Company B, is not a UBO.
knowledge_zh: 示例：个人 C 直接持股 10% 加间接持股 8%，未达到 UBO 标准

en_quote: In companies where there is no natural beneficial owner, a controller or a notional beneficial owner should be identified and verified. This allows you to understand who is in control of the decision-making in the company when natural individual UBOs are not present.
knowledge_zh: 无自然人受益所有人时，应识别并核实控制人或名义受益所有人

en_quote: For example, for a company that is publicly listed on the stock exchange and has thousands of shareholders, a notional beneficial owner could be the president or chief executive officer, or equivalent.
knowledge_zh: 示例：上市公司可将总裁或 CEO 作为名义受益所有人
